scope: Pinned reference geometry, inertias, collision proxies and coupled gripper. Authored native servos, privileged state and synthetic commands. No serial-specific calibration, measured hardware response, task policy or physical qualification.

protocol.repeat_scope: Repeated deterministic numerical/performance diagnostics, not independent physical or skill trials
protocol.pad_measurement: Euclidean distance between upstream left_pad1/right_pad1 geom centers; not calibrated inner jaw gap
protocol.convergence_scope: Matched 20 ms boundaries including post-settling start; adjacent timestep comparison, not comparison with reality

audit.scope: Pinned reference geometry, inertias, collision proxies and coupled gripper. Authored native servos, privileged state and synthetic commands. No serial-specific calibration, measured hardware response, task policy or physical qualification.

settings.mount: upstream attachment_site, gripper namespace, no added adapter mass
settings.tcp: upstream gripper/pinch; not a measured physical TCP

audit.gripper_command_unit: native 0–255 servo input; not meters or calibrated physical force

collision_probe.scope: Authored initial sphere overlap at an upper-arm collision proxy; no motion or real collision trial

attempts.timing_scope: mj_step calls with per-tick instrumentation; chunks also include boundary mj_forward. Excludes verification/compile, settling, sampling, rendering, perception, policy, transport and real actuation.
